faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What if I forgot my booking code?
faq.a1: You can check your SMS/Zalo confirmation or call our hotline 0987.654.321 to search by phone number.
faq.q2: When is my reservation officially confirmed?
faq.a2: Once your deposit is transferred, your status updates to 'Deposit Received' within 15-30 minutes.
faq.q3: Can I change rental dates or dress size?
faq.a3: Yes, please message Chickie on Zalo at least 2 days in advance for complimentary rescheduling.
